LeetCode #20: Valid Parentheses
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Given a string of brackets, determine if it's valid.

This is a CLASSIC interview problem that tests your
understanding of the STACK data structure.

Time: O(n)  |  Space: O(n)

The Key Insight: Use a STACK
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Why a stack? Because brackets must be closed in
REVERSE ORDER of how they were opened!

  "({[]})"  ←  Valid (LIFO order)
  "([)]"    ←  Invalid (wrong order)

The stack lets us track what's still "open".

Step 1: Create the Bracket Mapping
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

We map each CLOSING bracket to its OPENING pair.

This lets us quickly check: "Does this closer
match the most recent opener?"

  ')' → '('
  '}' → '{'
  ']' → '['

Step 2: Process Each Character
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

We iterate through the string one character at a time.

For each character, we need to decide:
  • Is it an OPENING bracket? → Push to stack
  • Is it a CLOSING bracket? → Check if it matches

Step 3: Handle CLOSING Brackets
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When we see a closing bracket:

1. Pop the top of the stack (most recent opener)
2. If stack is empty, use '#' as a dummy value
3. Check if the popped opener matches this closer

If they don't match → Invalid string!

Step 4: Handle OPENING Brackets
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When we see an opening bracket:

  Simply PUSH it onto the stack!

We'll deal with matching it later when we
encounter its corresponding closing bracket.

Step 5: Final Validation
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

After processing all characters:

  • Stack EMPTY → All brackets matched! ✓
  • Stack NOT EMPTY → Unmatched openers ✗

Return True only if len(stack) == 0

Test Cases
━━━━━━━━━━

  "()"      → True   (simple match)
  "()[]{}"  → True   (multiple pairs)
  "(]"      → False  (mismatched types)
  "([)]"    → False  (wrong order)
  "{[]}"    → True   (nested correctly)


  🎉 You've mastered Valid Parentheses!
